name: Mo Yi
source:
A psychiatrist who can see through all forms of disguises.

A top psychology expert who turned down all kinds of job invitations and decided to become a psychiatrist in Stellis City.

He has an elegant vibe and nothing seems to be of challenge to him. Those around him feel at ease and naturally open up to him, displaying their truest

self.

However, as someone who always observed the volatile human emotions from the outside, Vyn never expected himself to become one with the same emotions.

[Taken from [url=https://tot.mihoyo.com/en-us/information/all/detail/100129]Official site[/url]]

Born: 2003
Code name: Adjudicator
